short.lead: All six steps of issue #411 are built, and this page was built by the new QA mode, so it had to pass the evidence check itself. The proof is the Ophan page you were sent. Rebuilt from its own content, the builder on main still makes it with no clip or picture, and the new builder refuses it. Given evidence, the new builder makes the cards shown under Changes, using the real wings-spread clip and the real beam screenshots from Ophan pull request 445.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what was built and how it was checked.
items: The Ophan page is now a test

Sub-issue #412 (the Ophan page's content becomes a test that must be refused). The builder refuses a copy of that page's content when it is run in a test repo that uses the Ophan feature's file names.
Checked by verify.py, which also asserts that the refusal names the missing evidence.
The builder requires evidence by type

Sub-issue #413 (the page builder requires the evidence each change type needs). Each change in the page's qa.evidence list names its type: animation, model, ai, gameplay, visual, or none (with a reason). The changed files imply types too: an animator controller means animation, an .fbx file means model, a script under Scripts/Runtime means gameplay. The builder also refuses a page whose text names a picture or clip file that the page does not show.
Checked by verify.py, with one test case for each refusal, plus a test of a project overriding the file patterns in its page-style.json.
Pages show clips, before and after side by side

Sub-issue #414 (the page template shows video clips). Before and after clips sit side by side on a wide screen, one above the other on a phone, and play, pause and seek together. A file over 15 MB is refused.
Checked by verify.py and by the screenshots and recording under Changes.

Sub-issue #415 (the change list refuses a count of 0 changed files). The Ophan page said 0 files because the staging branch already held the feature. A count of 0 now stops the build, and the message says to count from the commit before the merge.
Checked by verify.py, with the Ophan test repo on a feature branch, so that the build is refused for missing evidence and not for the 0-file count.
The handover reply needs a proven page

Sub-issue #416 (the handover reply counts only a QA page whose evidence passed). The builder records the evidence it checked in the design-loop stage file. The check that runs at the end of each reply refuses a QA page that has no such record.
You look, then test it yourself
Sub-issue #417 (rule text, docs, version 2.74.0 and this page). Watch the recording and compare the before and after pictures under Changes, then try the builder on a real page of your own.
Send "QA passed: QA evidence by change type", or "QA failed: QA evidence by change type" with what to change.

changes: Two small bugs I found, not fixed here

First, the stage file stored this feature's name as "QA evidence by change type 1A 2A 3A"</message>", because the approval parser keeps a trailing quote and a closing tag. Second, the lock that blocks code edits outside the Build stage watches the Write and Edit tools but not a shell command that edits a source file. I suggest opening an issue for each bug.
